prompt: Create a native Android app called Java Runner that can create, open, edit, compile, and run Java .java files locally on the Android device. Include a code editor with syntax highlighting and line numbers, project/file manager, Compile and Run buttons, and a console to show real output, errors, and exceptions. Support multiple Java files and execute the main() method. Add Stop button for running programs and run compilation/execution in background so the app does not freeze. Do not fake compilation or console output; implement real Java source compilation and execution using a technically valid Android-compatible Java compiler/runtime. Use a modern dark Material Design UI.
Look at the build errors and fix them.
